code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Dashboard/Dashboard.tsx (empty), utils/Meta/Inbox.ts and the Inbox menu commented out (utils/data/LinkData.tsx); ocmsadminapi only has notifications to offenders (crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsSmsNotificationRecords) and error emails (utilities/ErrorNotificationAspect). No officer notification in the six repos
note: Status sheet: Demo paid (50% of 75%); no separate requirement is given. There is no code for officer notifications: the dashboard is empty and there is no notification entity/endpoint or read/unread marker. The 'Demo paid' status is not supported by code in the repos; the demo may have used another build or screen (cannot verify from repo). No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: No code. Do not claim as done; ask URA/the team which build was demonstrated, or mark it as a gap.

steps.step: A notification is routed to the officer's dashboard
steps.detail: The dashboard is empty (Dashboard.tsx:26-29). There is no officer notification entity or endpoint: 'notification' in ocmsadminapi only covers eNotification/SMS/email to offenders (OcmsSmsNotificationRecords.java:23) and technical error emails (ErrorNotificationAspect.java:18-28). Synonyms notification, alert, inbox, unread, mark as read were tried in ocmsadminui, ocmsadminapi and ocmsadminprivateapi: no officer notification exists. The Inbox menu ('View Hirer/Driver Updates', Meta/Inbox.ts:17-21) is also commented out (LinkData.tsx:385, :402).

steps.step: The officer clicks the notification to view it
steps.detail: There is no notification list or item to click; the dashboard page has no components (Dashboard.tsx:26-29).

steps.step: The officer marks the notification as read
steps.detail: There is no read/unread field or API for officer notifications (grep 'mark as read', 'unread', 'is_read' in ocmsadminui, ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi: only the form-readonly flags rep_is_read/coupons_eht_is_read in utils/mapping/REP.ts and Coupon.ts, which are not notifications).

steps.step: The notification is cleared from the dashboard after being read
steps.detail: There is no notification list on the dashboard to clear (Dashboard.tsx:26-29).
